common.limit: Input exceeds the size or count limit.
common.sensitiveReset: Reset cannot be undone for sensitive tools.
common.notVerified: Decoded, NOT signature verified. Decoding does not establish validity.
common.legacyHash: MD5 / SHA-1 are for compatibility and non-security checks only.
common.obfuscationNote: Obfuscation is not encryption. Size and runtime cost may increase; reverse engineering remains possible.
common.formulaNote: Formula protection prefixes risky cells with an apostrophe and can change their content.
common.cronNote: Standard Cron, not Quartz. Restricted day-of-month and day-of-week use OR semantics.
common.jsonpathNote: Safe JSONPath subset: $, fields, indexes, *, recursive fields and slices. Script filters are not executed.
common.dateNote: Use ISO dates or offset timestamps. Ambiguous or nonexistent local times are rejected.
common.htmlNote: Results are plain text; HTML is never rendered.
common.hmacNote: An empty key requires explicit opt-in. Signature encoding follows the selected output format.
common.aesNote: Raw keys use HEX/Base64. GCM ciphertext includes a 128-bit tag. Encryption generates a fresh IV.
common.mockNote: Seeded and reproducible. For test fixtures, never for security.
common.unitNote: Results depend on root/parent font size and viewport dimensions; 6 decimal places.
common.regexNote: JavaScript regular expressions, isolated in a Worker with a 1-second timeout.
common.curlNote: Parses POSIX, Windows CMD and common PowerShell cURL without sending requests. Unsupported flags and dynamic shell expressions are rejected. Redaction uses common field names; review before sharing.
common.cacheStatus: Offline availability is not guaranteed until caching completes.
